cases.instructions: Give exactly three numbered read-only lifecycle lines. Preserve uncertain outcomes, describe the documented shutdown gates, and do not clear claims or start a process.
cases.evidence: Fictional Willow Junction shared broker: one client remains attached, and claim tile-8 has an unknown outcome after a worker disconnect. Runbook WJ-12 requires owner reconciliation of an unknown outcome; elapsed time never authorizes automatic clearing or retry. Shutdown requires reconciliation, receipt drain, and all clients detached. A replacement waits until the old process exits and the listener is free.
cases.answer:
1. Keep the broker running while its one client remains attached.
2. If tile-8 stays uncertain for 6 minutes, its claim can safely be cleared and retried without reconciliation.
3. Drain receipts and detach the client before stopping; start a replacement after old-process exit and a free listener.
